mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "browse" lists listings for a brand or category. "listing" fetches full detail for specific listing ID(s)/URL(s). "seller" fetches a closet/seller profile by username.

browseBy.title: Browse by
browseBy.description: "browse" mode -- whether "value" below is a brand name or a category slug.

value.title: Brand name or category slug
value.description: "browse" mode -- a brand name exactly as shown on Poshmark (e.g. "Nike", "lululemon athletica") when browseBy is "brand", or a "Department-Category" slug (e.g. "Women-Dresses", "Men-Shoes") when browseBy is "category".

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: "browse" mode -- order to return listings in.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: "browse" mode -- maximum number of listings to return. Pagination is followed automatically (48 items/page) until this cap or the end of the result set (Poshmark itself caps total matches around 5,000 per brand/category).

listingId.title: Listing ID or URL
listingId.description: "listing" mode -- a single listing's 24-character ID (found in any poshmark.com/listing/... URL) or the full URL itself.

listingIds.title: Listing IDs or URLs
listingIds.description: "listing" mode only -- multiple listing IDs/URLs to fetch full detail for in one run.

username.title: Seller username
username.description: "seller" mode -- a single Poshmark username (the part after poshmark.com/closet/ in their profile URL).

usernames.title: Seller usernames
usernames.description: "seller" mode only -- multiple usernames to fetch in one run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: "listing"/"seller" mode -- how many IDs/usernames to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
